parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb get-create-table-sql --db-cluster-id am-uf6wjk5xxxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --schema-name adb_demo --table-name test --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb GetCreateTableSQL --region cn-hangzhou --TableName test --DBClusterId 'am-uf6wjk5xxxxxxxxxx' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SchemaName adb_demo
